name: get_selected_item_properties
author: hprebar
title: Get properties of the selected items
description: Property categories and values of the items currently selected in Navisworks (max maxItems, default 5), optionally one category only. Length values are converted to millimetres; everything else is the display string. Read-only; select items in Navisworks first.

maxItems.description: How many selected items to describe (every category of an item is ~5 KB of output)

category.description: Only this property category (display name, e.g. Item, Element); empty = every category
